qualityGate.reason: The test code is syntactically correct and should compile and run without errors. It uses Playwright APIs correctly with proper awaiting of asynchronous assertions. The testCaseIds are preserved in the test titles. However, selectors rely on placeholder text 'Category Name' which needs real category names to work in practice. Assumptions about the existence and class names of elements like '.product-item' and generic 'heading' role usage introduce selector fragility. Assertions check for basic navigation and element presence but do not validate that filtered products exactly match the selected category. This reduces assertion strength. No test data injection or reuse mechanisms are implemented, affecting maintainability and reusability. The code shows straightforward, readable test structure but could improve test data handling and selector robustness.
